name: ai-popover
title: AI popover
description: An AI suggestion beside the text it is about — what the AI did, the suggested text on a soft AI wash, then Discard, Try again and Replace.
docs: An AI suggestion beside the text it is about — what the AI did, the suggested text on a soft AI wash, then Discard, Try again and Replace. Do: Leave Replace as the plain solid button; the wash and the mark already say this came from AI. Don't: Put the AI gradient on Replace or on the suggested text — accepting has to feel like any other decision. Do: Wrap the selected text as the popover's anchor so it stays highlighted underneath for comparison. In a text box or an editor, where the selection cannot be wrapped, pass it as anchor instead and leave the text as it is. Don't: Cover or remove the original before the person has chosen. Do: Title the popover with the action and its flavour: "Rewrite: shorter". Don't: Title it "AI" or "Suggestion" — people should know what was asked without remembering it. Do: Leave the suggestion tile on the soft divider line (border-border). It is read-only content, told apart from the popover by its fill. Don't: Outline it with the control line (border-input) — that line marks things people press or type in. Use popover when the overlay holds an ordinary form or filter, not an AI suggestion. Use ai-message when the AI answers in a conversation rather than suggesting an edit to text on the page.
